explain_task.question: Using the revised model’s `MaxRevenue.lp_relaxation.json`, explain why the August gate is inactive in the LP relaxation even though `buy_8 = 300`, and identify which constraints are binding versus slack by naming the exact code constraints and their slack/dual values. Then compare the original objective 9100.0 to the revised MIP objective 7300.0: pinpoint the exact code additions that caused the 1800 drop, trace them back to the business brief and the CSV fields `august_bulk_order_threshold`, `august_bulk_receiving_fee`, and `fixed_order_cost`, and quantify which charges are actually incurred in the final integer solution using the variable names `buy_bin_9`, `buy_bin_11`, and `august_bulk_receiving`. Finally, explain the business meaning of the LP shadow price on the binding August threshold gate and why you cannot linearly extrapolate that marginal value to conclude the same per-unit effect beyond the 300-unit threshold in the integer model.
